resources.string: Status only: rates, cards, gray bands, executor, scratchboard, what happened today, to-dos
Status only — decisions are made in Decision Center
Same numbers as the governance outlet; nothing is recomputed here
Day %1$s · same numbers as the governance outlet
What this task is meant to deliver (same text as the governance port; not recomputed here)
Cannot read the board (not a text file)
This is Baopu\'s own note. Clearing it is permanent (no trash bin, no undo). Whatever it wants to keep it writes into the products folder first.
Only executed rows that carry a result (planned / suppressed / refused stay off this screen)
Cleared once: rows before %1$s are hidden (ledger untouched)
Only the newest entries are shown; older ones live in the ledger.
Clears this screen only (a local watermark): the ledger keeps every original row. Once cleared it cannot be undone — the watermark only moves forward.
Read the model\'s own working note (products/.board.md, max 4KB/20 lines). Read-only: no writes, no memory.
Replace the model\'s own working note (whole text, not append); refuses past 4KB/20 lines and asks to trim first; empty string clears it.
The model adds a to-do for itself (products/.todo.jsonl); one line, 40 characters max, refused if longer; the same item is never added twice.
Read the model\'s own to-do list (summary + state + the right minister\'s verdict). Read-only.
Mark a to-do as done. The right minister then verifies it: PASS moves it to completed, otherwise it stays at done. Only the user can remove it.
Only a PASS from the right minister reaches Completed. It leaves the board only when you tap Confirm; the ledger keeps every line.
Which commit this build is and which scaffolds are on — read-only collection, exported into the workspace products dir (dot-prefixed, not counted as products, never overwrites). No user content.
Record one item on the project ledger (workspace .zd-ledger.jsonl); one line, 40 characters max, and a source message id is required (no source, no entry).
Move an entry to flying/pending/frozen/withdrawn. Asking for accepted sends it to the right minister: only PASS sets it to accepted, otherwise it stays pending. Only the user can archive.
Read the model\'s own project ledger (one-line title + state + the right minister\'s verdict). Read-only; archived entries are hidden by default.
